# Fremtidens unicorns er i støbeskeen netop nu

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-05  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben episode from Euroinvestor. The opening market review covers gains in Genmab after positive Rina-S phase 2 data, gains in Alm. Brand, Tryg and the shipping stocks, and a weak C25 index held back by Novo Nordisk and DSV, with the panel urging caution on DSV ahead of its 21 October report. The panel also discusses weak US jobs data, a gradual rotation of money into Europe, and pressure on brewers and consumer staples. The main segment, with Christian Stig Møller of Nordic Bloom, covers US venture capital: the power law, top-quartile funds, AI dominating new start-ups, and upcoming IPOs from Anthropic and OpenAI.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 DSV — DSV | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 65%

Hosts warn of risk in the DB Schenker integration, the Saudi project and the lost Amazon deal; wait for the 21/10 report before buying.

#### Reasoning

Both the technical analyst (Lars) and Michelle are cautious. The integration is far larger than DSV's earlier deals and is taking longer, and ethics criticism plus Amazon choosing Kuehne+Nagel add pressure. Michelle won't jump in short-term and would wait for the report and proof that the integration is on or ahead of plan. Lars says 'pas lidt på' (be a bit careful).

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report on 21/10 shows integration problems
- if more customers are lost to competitors

> *"Ja, DSV er sådan lidt... Ja, pas lidt på i hvert fald."*

---

### 🟢 GMAB — Genmab | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Positive Rina-S phase 2 data in ovarian cancer adds a new growth leg; Michelle holds the stock personally.

#### Reasoning

Michelle had flagged the Rina-S data as a key catalyst in a data-heavy year for healthcare. The positive outcome could widen the patient population and allow earlier-line treatment, which supports earnings growth. The stock rose about 3.5%. Her personal position shows conviction.

#### Sell Triggers

- if later trial data disappoint
- if the growth legs fail to turn into earnings

> *"Hvis du kan få flere og flere vækstben, så er det jo klart, så er det jo positivt i forbindelse med indtjeningen."*

---

### 🟠 TRYG — Tryg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Jyske Bank (cited analyst) says Tryg looks interesting after it fell through a support line last week.

#### Reasoning

The view comes from a cited analyst (Jyske Bank), not the hosts. Lars notes the stock broke a technical support line last week and is bouncing today. Speculative.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it fails to recover above the broken support line

> *"her til morgen har Jyske Bank været ude og sige, at de synes, at den ser interessant ud"*

---

### 🟠 CARL B — Carlsberg | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Technically rejected at 950 and consolidating around 850; the India IPO could reduce debt; sector faces cost and demand headwinds.

#### Reasoning

Lars sees the planned India listing as a way to bring in cash and cut debt, but the stock was rejected at 950 and is consolidating. Brewers face higher distribution, energy, grain and aluminium costs, lower alcohol consumption and GLP-1 effects. Michelle notes brewers have struggled throughout 2026.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it breaks below the 850 consolidation level
- if aluminium costs rise as hedges roll off

> *"den var der på vej op, men blev afvist i 950, og så røg den tilbage til 850, og så konsolideres den"*
